# The ejected readonly proofs of generic receivers build with upstream Go and
# print the same lines as the native build: the readonly method obligations,
# the const view calls and the property getter on instantiated generic types
# erase to plain methods and plain types.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/readonly_generic_receiver.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/readonly_generic_receiver.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
exists $UPROOT1273/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1273/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.3 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/readonly_generic_receiver.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/readonlygenericeject

go 1.27
